subject: Econ & security sync — next steps and timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Econ & security sync — next steps and timeline

Hi Alicia / Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan.

Call highlights (30m):
- Primary econ buyer: Derek Lowe (CFO). He wants clear TCO and a 90-day POC ROI signal.
- Security lead: Lena Park (Head of InfoSec) will own evidence review; Samir is procurement lead for contracts.
- Key decision criteria: latency under 250ms 95th, SOC2 evidence, per-token unit economics, and data locality controls for PHI adjacency.

Suggested mutual action plan (high level):
1) Evidence & compliance (owner: Lena) — supply SOC2 Type II report, data handling summary, and optional on-prem deployment notes.
2) POC setup (owner: NovaMed + Redwood SE) — 2-week ingest + 4-week throughput test. Success: stable 95th percentile latency <250ms, cost per 1M tokens under $X, and no security findings blocking scope.
3) Procurement & contract (owner: Samir) — commercial terms draft and 60-day trial amendment.
4) Exec review (owner: Derek) — financial sign-off and deployment commitment.

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (POC timeline + roles), security-sla-questions.pdf (bullet list of security artifacts we can provide).

Proposed immediate next steps (can you confirm owners & timing):
- Monday 3/29: Redwood to share SOC2 artifacts + brief write-up of data flows (Jordon / Marissa).
- Wed 3/31: 30m technical call with Lena and our infra SE to walk controls.
- Week of 4/5: Kick off POC (if security review clears).

Can you confirm Derek wants to be looped directly for the exec review or should we run a pre-brief with Samir and send a 1-pager first?

Thanks — I put a draft MAP in the attached spreadsheet and highlighted the procurement gate.

—Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB); security-sla-questions.pdf (pdf, 46KB)
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Econ & security sync — next steps and timeline

Thanks Jordan — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Derek (CFO) prefers we surface a one-page financial summary before an exec meeting; please prepare a concise TCO/ROI slide. He will join only for the final decision review.
- Lena (InfoSec) asked to run an internal intake before the technical call; she requested the SOC2 report, network diagram, and any encryption/KMS notes. She should attend the 3/31 call.
- Procurement (me / Samir) will want a 60-day pilot amendment included in the commercial draft; Samir will own contract language.

Samir — I put some tentative time slots on Wed 3/31 for a 30m security tech review (10:00 or 14:00 PT). Which works for you?

A couple of procurement notes: we prefer to validate performance on our pre-prod environment (data-masked) and we will need a short SOW that states scope, acceptance criteria, and trial duration. Also include a line about data deletion at trial end.

Appreciate the attachments — I'll review and come back with any follow-up questions.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
VP of Strategic Partnerships 
NovaMed Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

On Mon, Mar 29, 2027 at 08:03 AM Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side:
> - Derek (CFO) prefers we surface a one-page financial summary before an exec meeting; please prepare a concise TCO/ROI slide.
>
Thanks Alicia — adding a few concrete milestones and owners below (pulled into the MAP tab of the attached spreadsheet). Suggested dates assume we start documentation exchange this week: 

Suggested milestones (dates are target, flexible):
- 2027-03-29: Redwood delivers SOC2 and data flow summary (owner: Jordan / Marissa) — DONE (attached).
- 2027-03-31: Security review call with Lena + infra SE (owner: NovaMed / Redwood) — Schedule 30m (proposed 10:00 PT).
- 2027-04-05: Kick-off POC (owner: NovaMed + Redwood) — POC scope: 4 weeks of throughput/latency testing + 2-week integration.
- 2027-04-30: POC wrap & results review; produce exec one-pager for Derek (owner: Marissa).
- 2027-05-10: Procurement completes contract redlines; anticipated commercial close (owner: Samir).

POC success criteria (draft):
- 95th percentile latency < 250ms with production-like workload.
- End-to-end feature parity for targeted use cases.
- No unresolved critical security findings after remediation window.
- Cost projection that meets Derek's <N% ROI threshold (we will model this).

Attachments from Redwood: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (MAP + timeline), security-sla-questions.pdf (artifacts list). I also added a column in the MAP for acceptance criteria and what each owner must provide.

Jordan: I'll prepare the TCO one-pager and a short deck for Derek by 4/28 so you have time to preview.

Samir / Alicia: confirm whether 10:00 PT on 3/31 works for the security tech review or propose an alternate slot.

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Alicia / Samir / Marissa — thanks for the confirmations. Quick updates: 
- 3/31 10:00 PT is confirmed for the security tech review (calendar invite sent). Lena is on the invite.
- Jordan note: SOC2 & data flow doc uploaded to the Drive link (see thread related links).
- Marissa: appreciate you taking the TCO one-pager. If useful, I'll draft a short budget scenario and send it tonight for your edits.

Next immediate asks (action owners):
- Jordan: upload a minimal SOW template and pilot amendment for Samir to iterate (EOD Wed).
- Marissa: finalize TCO one-pager draft by 2027-04-28 and add a POC acceptance checklist in the MAP.
- Samir: prepare a short list of contract must-haves (trial length, termination, data deletion) before the POC start.

I'll follow up after the security call with a concise decision timeline we can present to Derek (one-pager + slide). Looking forward to the 4/5 kickoff if all clears.

Thanks —
Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
